text:
Asking rents in Frankfurt stand at a median of 17.50 €/m² (2026-06), up 3.2% on the year and +24.4% over five years. That ranks Frankfurt #2 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 65% above the 2022 average contract rent of 10.58 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 1050 € a month in cold rent, 21.4% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 25 days and 31% are gone within a week; with 1.9% market-active vacancy and +3.3% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 18.52 €/m² (+5.8%), with an 80% range of 18.00 to 18.96 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
